title: Move Studio Simulator
author: Own-Satisfaction5439
selftext:
Hey everyone i made a hollywood movie simulator in chatgpt… and I wanted to share it with you all (Game in Comment)

It’s a browser-based movie studio management simulator where you can run a single studio or manage an entire industry in Empire Mode.

The game includes real-world studio brands, film franchises and IPs, greenlighting and production management, budgets, marketing, release dates, box office results, international markets, talent management, awards, acquisitions, and financial tracking.

This is a project I built with ChatGPT, and I’m finally getting it ready to share publicly. I’d really appreciate feedback from people who enjoy management sims, movie studios, Hollywood, or the business side of filmmaking.

Thanks!
